findings.location: app/src/main/java/com/example/projectacc/MyAccessibilityService.kt findAndClickCloseButton picks the rightmost blank ImageView
findings.claim: The close button is located geometrically as the ImageView with blank contentDescription and text that is farthest right on screen. In the observed popup tree every other icon sits left of its text so the X wins, but a future Picap layout with a right-side icon could be clicked instead. The Aceptar-node guard limits the branch to service popups; a misclick is a harmless tap and the CLOSE log records the chosen bounds for diagnosis.
proof_refs: app/src/main/java/com/example/projectacc/MyAccessibilityService.kt findAndClickCloseButton selects max bounds.right among candidates
logcat CLOSE candidato X emits chosen right coordinate

findings.claim: Non-Cruz-Verde detection reuses servicio, which only matches a non-address node containing cruz verde. The 0.5 s re-check gives the popup time to render that node and skips the close when it appears, which removes the premature-close race. Residual risk: a Picap render slower than 0.5 s whose only Cruz Verde text is an address would still be closed as non-CV. The NO-CV log lines (scheduled, closed, or node-appeared) make any misclassification visible in logcat.
proof_refs: app/src/main/java/com/example/projectacc/MyAccessibilityService.kt closeNonCvPopup parses the live tree after the delay
NO-CV log distinguishes closed versus node-appeared outcomes

findings.location: app/src/main/java/com/example/projectacc/MyAccessibilityService.kt NO-CV branch runs before the auto-accept switch check
findings.claim: The close action is unconditional per the explicit request: non-CV popups are dismissed even when the Picap auto-accept master switch is off, so a user browsing manually will never see a non-CV offer. No data is registered and no accept click happens, so nothing irreversible occurs, but if browsing non-CV offers becomes desirable the branch will need a switch guard.
proof_refs: NO-CV branch placed before updateKmOverlay and before the isPicapAutoAcceptEnabled gate
user request states close the overlay automatically when the service is not Cruz Verde

findings.claim: pendingCloseId deduplicates timers so concurrent events schedule one close attempt per order id, and lastClosedId is set only on a successful click, so a failed click retries on the next event with a fresh 0.5 s window (bounded by popup lifetime). Residual case: a click that reports success while the popup fails to close leaves the offer open with no automatic retry, until the user dismisses it manually.
